finalText:
Here's the story from `logs/app.log`.

At 02:14:07, redis dropped: `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Everything was fine right up to that second, no earlier warnings.

The app fell back to hitting the store directly instead of using cache. From there it snowballed. Requests kept timing out, the queue kept growing, and it tried reconnecting to redis every 80 seconds but never got back in, 12 tries, all failed.

By 02:31:44 the queue backlog was too big and a worker ran out of memory. The supervisor restarted it, but the whole api process group was already stuck and got killed at 02:31:52, taking prod down.

So the root cause is redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` going unreachable. Worth checking why that box dropped, since the app itself just kept struggling without it until it collapsed.
